messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026.3.1 -> eu-west1 flagged: memory_usage spike at 03:12 UTC, p95 latency +45% (canary 5%). auto-rollback threshold breached.
alex: seeing it. can someone paste the canary logs?
lina: grabbing logs now — looks like a regression in the tokenizer shard allocation after quant change. short snippet:
```
2026-03-20T03:11:58Z service: model-infer pid=4231 mem=2.9G -> 7.8G
WARN KVCache: unexpected growth on shard 3
```

alex: thanks. do we have a quick mitigation? pin to previous model or roll back service?
tim: we can pin the model variant for eu-west1 to 2026.3.0 (quant=8bit) while we investigate. pin command: `rwctl pin model/redwood-llama-3@2026.3.0 --region eu-west1 --reason "canary memory spike"`
alex: whats the impact on latency/cost if we pin?
lina: negligible perf hit, slight cost increase (~3%) but stable. recommended.
maria: product side — we need release notes update and customer comms if this extends >30m. who owns that?
sre-oncall: I can do the emergency comms draft once we decide. we need expedited approval to apply pin during change window.
alex: change window is 03:00-04:00 UTC, we're within. I approve pin for eu-west1. @maria please ack for comms.
maria: ack — please include a note that embeddings customers may see small perf diffs.
deploy-bot: `action_required`: manual approval needed to run `rwctl pin` (safety gate).
alex: running approval: /approve-pin eu-west1 pin-2026.3.0 by alex at 03:13
linA: (typo) lina: executing pin now and will monitor metrics for 10m.
deploy-bot: Rollout step: pin submitted, job id 987654.
tim: pin applied — verifying endpoints.
linA: (typo fix) lina: endpoints report model@2026.3.0. memory stabilizing. p95 latency returning to baseline.
sre-oncall: drafting comms, will post in #status in 10m.
maria: approved for public note. add a line about ongoing investigation & ETA 2-4 hours.
alex: good. we'll keep this pinned until next safe release. postmortem ticket created: RN-2026-118.
lina: creating a follow-up PR to revert quant change in next patch and add extra kvcache tests.
alex: thanks everyone. tagging for postmortem: @tim @lina @sre-oncall @maria :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary monitoring OK after pin. closing expedited loop.
